svg.title: Reading speed at long context on a MacBook Pro M3 Max
svg.desc: Line chart of reading speed from 48K to 128K tokens: DeepSeek falls from about 157 to 115 tokens per second while GLM stays roughly flat around 120 to 133, crossing above DeepSeek at the end
